digest.component_or_area: store initialization and project mapping migration
propositions: Existing stores lack .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project ticket field, causing all tickets to resolve as absent-project with no legacy default fallback on upgrade

The migration must seed the projects mapping with legacy_default and a single Backend.project entry without writing ticket events to avoid silent convergence failures during MCP boot on contended locks

Two idempotent ensure units must be added to the registry: one to seed the mapping if absent (check-then-act with zero commits when converged) and one to conditionally stamp multi-project-bridge capability only when the mapping has multiple projects
The projects mapping and capability stamp must converge automatically at store init/re-init and fsck --repair with no operator action required
A single-project seeded store must never receive the multi-project-bridge stamp, and a two-project stamped store must still pass check_store_store_compat on this binary
Unit code belongs in new src/rebar/_store/project_ensures.py for cohesion, with two registry entries added to ensures.py and test_registry_id_set_is_frozen hardcoded literal updated
